university: Lovely Professional University, Phagwara, Punjab, India
summary_statement: In strict compliance with academic rigor and data integrity protocols, zero fictional floor plans have been fabricated. All 43 audited buildings currently require manual mapping or administrative blueprint acquisition, as LPU internal architectural CAD drawings are proprietary and restricted.

known_architectural_pattern.typical_layout_composition: Central or double-loaded spine corridor flanked by classrooms, tutorial halls, and faculty cubicles
known_architectural_pattern.estimated_rooms_per_floor: 12 to 16 rooms / laboratories per standard academic floor
known_architectural_pattern.vertical_circulation: Central staircase and elevator core, with secondary emergency fire stairs at wing ends
known_architectural_pattern.utilities: Restrooms and drinking water stations positioned adjacent to vertical stairwell cores
